finding.title: 5 clients lock within 10 days: Rs 42.6 lakh at risk
finding.detail: Sunrise Pharma (Rs 14,20,012, locks 22-Nov), Royal Spices (Rs 9,85,300, 23-Nov), Green Valley Dairy (Rs 7,39,860, 25-Nov), Neelgiri Aqua (Rs 6,30,120, 27-Nov), Bharat Home Care (Rs 4,84,980, 30-Nov). Royal Spices promised payment on 25-Nov, which is after its lock date.
